exposure: Use of ventouse compared with forceps
use of ventouse compared with forceps
outcome: Cesarean delivery during the second stage of labor
cohort: 3,798 attempted instrumental deliveries of vertex-presenting, single, term newborns in a tertiary United Kingdom center
finding: Birth weight and head position were the most important factors in successful instrumental delivery, while instrument selection and rotational delivery appeared to be operator-dependent.
mod_finding: Instrument selection and decision to rotate were not associated with instrumental delivery success when interobstetrician variability was controlled for.
